blurb: iBowl.ca Family Fun Center offers 8 lanes of Cosmic 5 and 10-pin bowling, Cosmic Indoor Mini Golf, arcade games, air hockey, basketball shooting game, and pool table. The facility is located on the second story of a historic former shoe factory in downtown Galt, Cambridge, Ontario. It specializes in children's birthday parties, youth group parties, and corporate parties.
